checks.exercise: Bilateral seated ankle dorsiflexion, distinct from heel raises
checks.equipment: Bilateral plate-loaded levers, footboards, forefoot rollers, heel pivots and stable seat
checks.setup: 토 레이즈 머신 앞 의자에 앉아 뒤꿈치를 지지대에 두고 앞꿈치를 발등 패드 아래에 넣는다.
checks.hands: Relaxed open hands held above thighs; no simulated support force
checks.feet: Fixed bilateral virtual heel pivots; toes rise together
checks.movement: 뒤꿈치를 고정한 채 발끝을 당겨 저항 레버를 들어 올렸다가 천천히 내린다.

limitations: Generic simplified tibialis machine, not an exact manufacturer model; 25-degree procedural ankle rotation.
Heel pivots are rig landmarks; forefoot rollers and support boards use approximate contact; no tissue compression.
Sampled geometry and lever movement, not complete collision certification.
